t: Guide to Buying and Using a Touch ‘n Go Card in Singapore [2026 ]

Petrol stations in Singapore that sell Touch ‘n Go Cards include Caltex, Sinopec, Shell, and SPC. Cheers’ convenience stores in Esso stations are also included in the participating outlets.
